subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw adopt native outbound Telegram album sending now, using the linked fork PR as the starting point, or keep current sequential multi-media fan-out until maintainers choose a narrower channel contract?
rationale: This is a new visible Telegram channel capability with an open implementation candidate and multiple closed prior attempts, so a separate automated repair should not supersede contributor work or choose album semantics without owner direction.

options.title: Review or port the linked PR
options.body: Use the open fork PR as the starting point, update it for current Telegram plugin boundaries, and require focused tests plus live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Define a narrower album contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify exactly which surfaces and media kinds should use native albums before implementation.

options.title: Defer album semantics
options.body: Treat current sequential `mediaUrls` fan-out as the supported behavior for now and explicitly defer native Telegram album grouping.

recommendation.title: Review or port the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the open fork PR as the starting point, update it for current Telegram plugin boundaries, and require focused tests plus live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest routing signal from the prior cleanup review, PR 93862 merge, and recent Telegram-area history.
